description: This file defines an abstract class 'FieldConfigBase' for configurable field definitions in Drupal, including properties, methods for managing field settings, dependencies, default values, constraints, and serialization.

classes.name: FieldConfigBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for configurable field definitions in Drupal, managing properties, dependencies, default values, constraints, and serialization.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the field, composed of entity type, bundle, and field name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the field name.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the field type.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID the field is attached to.

methods.name: getTargetBundle
methods.description: Returns the bundle name the field is attached to.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates and adds dependencies related to the field type, bundle, and plugin definitions.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies and checks if dependencies affect the field.

methods.name: postCreate
methods.description: Post-creation hook to initialize field type and settings if not provided.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after field deletion, clearing caches and notifying storage.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles cache invalidation after saving the field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label of the field.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the human-readable label of the field.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the field.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the field.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if the field is translatable.

methods.name: setTranslatable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is translatable.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the field's settings.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets the field's settings.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific setting value.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a specific setting value.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the field is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the field is required.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field, possibly using a callback.

methods.name: getDefaultValueLiteral
methods.description: Returns the default value as stored.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: getDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Returns the callback function for default values.

methods.name: setDefaultValueCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function for default values.

methods.name: createFromItemType
methods.description: Creates a field definition from an item type.

methods.name: createFromDataType
methods.description: Creates a field definition from a data type.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the field.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Indicates if the field is a list.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for the field's list type.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns the constraints applied to the field.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Retrieves a specific constraint by name.

methods.name: getItemDefinition
methods.description: Returns the data definition of a field item.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object for a given bundle.

methods.name: setConstraints
methods.description: Sets multiple constraints for the field.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a constraint to the field.

methods.name: setPropertyConstraints
methods.description: Sets constraints for a specific property.

methods.name: addPropertyConstraints
methods.description: Adds constraints to a specific property.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Checks if the field is internal or computed.
